text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Recent job starts among employed young people aged 15–29
People currently employed whose current job began in the survey month or preceding two months.
The numerator is a surviving recent-start stock; the denominator is employed young people with a valid start date.
This is not a complete hiring flow, a first-job rate or the probability that an unemployed person finds work.
